subject.title: fix(qa): reject runtime tool intent without result evidence

question: Should QA release readiness require exactly the three result-backed runtime tools named by this PR, with the nine report-only or native-workspace rows remaining non-required?
rationale: This is a deliberate release-gate policy change, not a mechanical correction that source inspection can resolve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Confirm the three-tool gate
options.body: Approve the proposed contract: only `session-status`, `web-fetch`, and `web-search` are required until other scenarios can produce canonical successful call/result evidence.

options.title: Keep additional tools required
options.body: Name the additional scenarios that must remain release-blocking and require each to gain result-backed runtime proof before this PR lands.

recommendation.title: Confirm the three-tool gate
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed contract: only `session-status`, `web-fetch`, and `web-search` are required until other scenarios can produce canonical successful call/result evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged persisted-result parity repair establishes the collector and evidence boundary this PR extends.
